rotateKeyDescription: This will generate a new team encryption key and re-encrypt all team passwords and entries with it.
rotateKeyWarning1: All team entries will be re-encrypted. This may take a while for large teams.
rotateKeyWarning2: Members who are not online will receive the new key automatically when they next connect.
rotateKeyWarning3: This action cannot be undone. Ensure all members are active before rotating.
rotateKeyFailed: Key rotation failed. Please try again.
rotateKeyFetchFailed: Failed to load team data for rotation.
rotateKeyRateLimited: Too many rotation attempts. Please wait and try again.
rotateKeyVersionConflict: Key version conflict. Another rotation may be in progress.
rotateKeyEntryMismatch: Entry count mismatch. Please refresh and try again.
rotateKeyVaultRequired: Your vault must be unlocked to rotate the team key.
rotateKeyNoMembers: No active members with encryption keys found.
rotateKeyAborted: A team key could not be loaded, so nothing was changed. Check your connection and try again.
rotateKeyMembersChanged: The team's members changed while preparing the rotation. Refresh and try again.
rotateKeySuccessWithCarry: Team key rotated. {count, plural, one {# entry was} other {# entries were}} left unchanged and still need re-keying.
rekeyFinishDescription: After a rotation, each entry gets a new encryption key so that content saved from now on cannot be read with the old one. Entries are re-keyed one at a time; you can run this again to resume.
rekeyNothingPending: All entries use the current team key.
rekeyLoadFailed: Could not load the re-key status.
rekeyPendingCount: {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} waiting to be re-keyed
rekeyStateNeedsRekeyerHolder: Need an owner or admin who holds the older key: {count}
rekeyStateHolderCannotRekey: Only members without admin rights hold the older key: {count}
rekeyStateUnrecoverable: No active member holds the older key: {count}
rekeyRetainedHistory: {count, plural, one {# history version is} other {# history versions are}} kept under an older key
rekeyCompleted: Re-key finished: {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} re-keyed.
rekeyStopped: Re-key stopped after {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}.
rekeyStopTransient: A key or request failed temporarily. Nothing more was sent; run Finish re-key again.
rekeyStopStepUpDeclined: Re-authentication was not completed. Run Finish re-key again to resume.
rekeyStopCurrentKeyUnavailable: Your copy of the current team key could not be opened. Ask an owner or admin to check your key distribution.
rekeyStopRetryBudget: The team key kept changing, the team stayed busy, or requests were rate limited. Try again later.
rekeyIssueUndecryptable: {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} saved under an older team key could not be decrypted with your key.
rekeyIssueKeyInvalid: Your copy of an older team key cannot be opened — another member who holds that key re-keys {count, plural, one {this entry} other {these # entries}}.
rekeyIssueNeedsRekeyerHolder: {count, plural, one {# entry needs} other {# entries need}} an owner or admin who holds the older key.
rekeyIssueHolderCannotRekey: {count, plural, one {# entry's} other {# entries'}} older key is held only by members without admin rights.
rekeyIssueUnrecoverable: No active member holds the key for {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}.
rekeyIssueSkipped: {count, plural, one {# entry was} other {# entries were}} skipped: {reason}
rekeyKeySuspicion: Your copy of team key version {version} may be wrong — compare it with another member who holds that version.
rekeyExitAnotherHolderNamed: Ask a holder of the key to run Finish re-key: {holders}
rekeyExitAnotherHolder: Ask another member who holds the older team key to run Finish re-key
rekeyExitRestoreCurrentVersion: Restore a history version saved under the current key
rekeyExitCompareKeys: Compare keys with a team owner or admin
rekeyExitTemporaryPromotion: Temporarily promote a holder to admin so they can re-key (the role change is audited)
rekeyExitDeleteDeactivatedHolder: A member who left the organization still holds this key and could read the entry again if they return; deleting removes it for them too.
rekeyOlderKeyHolders: Holders of an older team key: {holders}
rekeySkipAttachmentUnopenable: an attachment could not be opened with any key you hold
rekeySkipRetryExhausted: the entry kept changing while it was being re-keyed
rekeySkipUndecryptable: the entry could not be decrypted with your key
